name: serpapi_ebay_product
description: Fetch one eBay product page by numeric product_id from listing URLs (/itm/{id}). Use for 'show this eBay listing', 'eBay product details for this item', or after serpapi_ebay_search when a product_id is known. Returns title, buy/bid prices, shipping, quantity, images, variations, seller, and related products. Prefer no_cache=false unless a live scrape is needed. Do not search by product name here; search first.

locale.description: Optional SerpApi locale for search origin.

lang.description: Optional language override (see SerpApi docs; US domain + locale).

shipping_country.description: Optional ISO-style shipping country for shipping quotes (SerpApi shipping_country).

no_cache.description: Bypass SerpApi cache when true. Default false.

extra_params.description: Additional SerpApi parameters excluding reserved keys.

include_raw.description: Include full SerpApi payload under data.raw.

availability.setup_hint: Set SERP_API_KEY in the active mode env file.
